45% of their third downs have been 7+ to go (league 46%), and there they are 30th at −0.47 EPA per play.

On early downs they run up the middle on 61 of 172 runs (35%; league 27%) for 3.4 yards a carry, though it hasn't worked: −0.21 EPA per play, 25th of 32. On early-down runs they've been most vulnerable off tackle (4.4 yards a carry and +0.02 EPA allowed, 9th-most in the league) and toughest inside (3.4 yards a carry, −0.23, 5th-fewest).
